name: Photovoltaic generator
summary: A photovoltaic generator represents the electrical production of PV cells or modules.
description: A photovoltaic generator represents the electrical production of PV cells or modules. On an SLD it is linked to documented series/parallel strings, DC protection and the inverter interface.
readingNotes: Differentiate the generating array from its inverter and any energy-storage branch.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: The PV generator is a DC generating function; the inverter produces the documented AC interface.
